svg.title: Evolution — phases concept P2: the rock pool, its creatures to scale
svg.desc: The five single-cell forms as the player arrives in the rock pool, next to the pool's food, threats and giants, all sea-water species. Code-drawn.
svg.text: · concept P2 — THE ROCK POOL · who lives there, sized against you
Game scale: your form is 1× on arrival (all five forms arrive at the same size, for fair play). Real sizes are in the chart below.
decided: tickets #785 A, #790 A · design: docs/game-design/phases.md §14.6
A · THE LINEUP — game scale, your form = 1×
a floor line, left to right by size · cyan = you · other colours = the pool
